title.zh: 两种花晶体管的办法：缓存，还是更多线程
title.en: Two ways to spend transistors: caches or more threads

description.zh: CPU 用大缓存和乱序执行让一个线程少等；GPU 同时养很多线程，一个在等就换另一个。拖命中率和线程数，看两种机器各忙多少。
description.en: A CPU spends area on caches and out-of-order execution so one thread waits less; a GPU keeps many threads and switches when one waits. Drag the hit rate and the thread count to see how busy each machine is.

en: why GPUs have so many cores
how does a graphics card work

title.zh: 网格、线程块、线程束：一张图怎么拆给两百万个线程
title.en: Grid, block, warp: splitting an image across two million threads

description.zh: 程序员只写一个像素怎么算；硬件按块分给 SM，每 32 个线程切成一个线程束。选图和块的形状，看要多少块、多少线程白跑、某个像素落在哪个线程束。
description.en: The programmer writes how one pixel is computed; hardware hands blocks to SMs and cuts every 32 threads into a warp. Pick an image and a block shape to see how many blocks, how many idle threads, and which warp a pixel lands in.

zh: CUDA 网格 线程块 线程

description.zh: 调度器每拍从准备好的线程束里挑一个发指令。逐拍模拟要多少线程束才能藏住显存的几百拍，再看 H100 的一个 SM 被寄存器、共享内存卡住只能养几个。
description.en: Each cycle the scheduler issues from one ready warp. A cycle-by-cycle simulation shows how many warps hide hundreds of cycles of memory latency, and how registers and shared memory limit what one H100 SM can hold.

zh: 寄存器太多 占用率低

title.zh: 分支发散：一个线程束走了两条路
title.en: Warp divergence: one warp, two paths

description.zh: 32 个线程只有一条指令流，在 if 上分开时两条路都要走一遍。拖走 if 的比例，看效率怎么掉。
description.en: A warp has one instruction stream, so when its threads split at an if, both paths run in turn. Drag the share that takes the branch to see the efficiency fall.

zh: GPU 上 if 为什么慢
en: why if statements are slow on GPU

title.zh: 合并访存：32 个地址，几次读
title.en: Memory coalescing: 32 addresses, how many reads

description.zh: 一个线程束的 32 次读按 32 字节一段取。挨着读取 4 段，按步长读最多取 32 段。改访问方式，看搬来的字节用上多少。
description.en: A warp's 32 loads are served in 32-byte sectors: adjacent addresses need 4, a stride can need 32. Change the access pattern and see how much of the moved data is used.

title.zh: 共享内存的 bank 冲突

description.zh: 共享内存分成 32 个 bank，每个 bank 每拍交出一个字。按步长读，看几路冲突；32×32 的块按列读，补一列就不冲突。
description.en: Shared memory has 32 banks, each delivering one word per cycle. Read with a stride to see the conflict degree; reading a 32×32 tile by column conflicts until each row gets one word of padding.

zh: 共享内存 bank 冲突

title.zh: 分块矩阵乘法的两级屋顶
title.en: Tiled matrix multiply: two levels of roofs

description.zh: 先搬一块进共享内存，再搬一小块进寄存器反复用。选块大小和每线程的小块，看显存、共享内存和峰值三层哪一层先压下来。
description.en: Stage a tile in shared memory, then a smaller block in registers, and reuse it. Pick the tile size and per-thread block to see which of three roofs (memory, shared memory, peak) binds first.

title.zh: 矩阵乘加指令与数字格式
title.en: Matrix multiply-accumulate instructions and number formats

description.zh: 一条 MMA 指令让整个线程束算一小块矩阵乘加；格式越窄峰值越高，但矩阵要够大才喂得饱。选卡、格式和矩阵大小，看能跑多快。
description.en: One MMA instruction has the whole warp compute a small matrix multiply-accumulate; narrower formats have higher peaks, but only large matrices can feed them. Pick a GPU, a format and a size to see the speed.

title.zh: 像素按 2×2 着色：小三角形为什么费
title.en: Shading in 2×2 quads: why small triangles cost

description.zh: 顶点和像素也变成线程上 SM，像素按 2×2 一组着色。拖三角形大小，看盖住的像素和要跑的线程差多少。
description.en: Vertices and pixels also become threads on the SMs, and pixels are shaded in 2×2 quads. Drag the triangle size to compare the pixels covered with the threads run.

title.zh: GPU 的存储层次，和不做的一致性
title.en: The GPU memory hierarchy, and the coherence it skips

description.zh: 每个 SM 有自己的寄存器和 L1/共享内存，全片共用 L2，再往外是显存。各 SM 的 L1 之间不做硬件一致性，跨块交接要靠原子操作和栅栏。
description.en: Each SM has its own registers and L1/shared memory; the chip shares an L2, then device memory. The SMs' L1s are not kept coherent by hardware, so handing data between blocks needs atomics and fences.

zh: GPU 为什么不做缓存一致性

title.zh: 前沿在哪（2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: Blackwell Ultra、Rubin、MI355X 和 MI455X：格式更窄、峰值更高、显存跟不上；双芯片封装；CUDA 与 ROCm 的版本。
description.en: Blackwell Ultra, Rubin, MI355X and MI455X: narrower formats, higher peaks, memory that cannot keep up; two-die packages; CUDA and ROCm releases.

title.zh: 写 GPU 代码前问三件事
title.en: Three questions before writing GPU code

description.zh: 拆得开吗、走得齐吗、读得近吗：把前面各章收成一张清单，再指向讲内存、缓存和互连的各篇。
description.en: Can it be split, do the threads move together, are the reads close: the chapters condensed into a checklist, with pointers to the essays on memory, caches and interconnects.

zh: 怎么写快的 CUDA 代码
en: why is my GPU code slow

label.zh: 调度器把利特尔法则跑出来

reason.zh: 第 3 章的线程束调度器逐拍模拟第 1 章「线程够多就能藏住延迟」的式子，并给出它的闭式解。
reason.en: Chapter 3’s warp scheduler simulates, cycle by cycle, chapter 1’s rule that enough threads hide the latency, and checks it against the closed form.

label.en: The unit of scheduling is the warp

reason.zh: 第 3 章调度和占用率算的，是第 2 章从线程块切出来的 32 线程一组的线程束。
reason.en: Chapter 3 schedules and counts the warps of 32 threads that chapter 2 cuts out of a thread block.

label.zh: 一个线程束同走一条指令

reason.zh: 第 4 章的分支发散，来自第 2 章的线程束里 32 条通道共用一条指令。
reason.en: Chapter 4’s divergence comes from chapter 2’s warp, whose 32 lanes share one instruction.

label.zh: 32 个线程编号变成 32 个地址

reason.zh: 第 5 章按第 2 章的线程编号 x + y·Dx 算出一个线程束的 32 个地址，再数落进几个 32 字节扇区。
reason.en: Chapter 5 turns chapter 2’s thread index x + y·Dx into a warp’s 32 addresses and counts the 32-byte sectors they fall in.

label.zh: 同一种「32 个地址」的账

reason.zh: 第 6 章的 bank 冲突和第 5 章的合并访存问的是同一件事：一个线程束的 32 个地址要分几次服务，只是换到共享内存的 32 个 bank 上。
reason.en: Chapter 6 asks chapter 5’s question again, how many passes a warp’s 32 addresses need, on shared memory’s 32 banks.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的分块放进共享内存，读法要避开第 6 章的 bank 冲突。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s tiles sit in shared memory and must be read without chapter 6’s bank conflicts.

label.zh: 同一个屋顶，换成张量核心
label.en: The same roofline, on tensor cores

reason.zh: 第 8 章把第 7 章的屋顶线搬到张量核心上，看各种数字格式的峰值在多大的矩阵才喂得饱。
reason.en: Chapter 8 carries chapter 7’s roofline over to the tensor cores and asks how large a matrix each format needs to reach its peak.

reason.zh: 第 9 章把三角形覆盖的 2×2 像素组装进第 2 章的 32 通道线程束。
reason.en: Chapter 9 packs a triangle’s 2×2 pixel quads into chapter 2’s 32-lane warps.

label.zh: 缓存是另一种藏延迟的办法
label.en: The cache is the other way to hide latency

reason.zh: 第 1 章用 CPU 缓存那篇第 1 章的平均访问时间，和 GPU 靠多线程藏延迟对照。
reason.en: Chapter 1 sets the CPU-cache essay’s average access time (its chapter 1) against the GPU’s way of hiding latency with threads.

reason.zh: 第 1 章算要多少线程才藏得住一次显存读，用的是内存那篇第 4 章的利特尔法则。
reason.en: Chapter 1 works out how many threads hide one memory read with the memory essay’s Little’s law (its chapter 4).

label.en: A CPU waits with its out-of-order window

reason.zh: 第 1 章把 GPU 的做法和 CPU 靠乱序窗口在一个线程里找活干（猜着往前跑那篇第 9 章）对照。
reason.en: Chapter 1 contrasts the GPU with a CPU finding work inside one thread through its out-of-order window (the guessing-ahead essay, chapter 9).

reason.zh: 内存那篇第 6 章说 GPU 在线程束之间零周期切换来掩盖延迟；第 3 章把这台调度器逐拍跑出来。
reason.en: The memory essay’s chapter 6 says a GPU switches between warps at no cost to hide latency; chapter 3 runs that scheduler cycle by cycle.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的 GPU 分块，沿用内存那篇第 3 章矩阵分块与时间局部性的道理，多了共享内存和寄存器两级。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s GPU tiling follows the memory essay’s matrix tiling (its chapter 3), with two levels, shared memory and registers.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的两级屋顶，是内存那篇第 7 章屋顶线模型每一级各算一次。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s two roofs are the memory essay’s roofline (its chapter 7) applied once per level.

label.en: Narrower formats move the ridge right

reason.zh: 第 8 章按内存那篇第 7 章的屋顶线，看每种数字格式要多大的矩阵才到峰值。
reason.en: Chapter 8 uses the memory essay’s roofline (its chapter 7) to see how large a matrix each number format needs to reach its peak.

reason.zh: 第 8 章讲内存那篇第 6 章提到的张量核心按什么指令、什么格式工作。
reason.en: Chapter 8 shows which instructions and formats drive the tensor cores the memory essay names in its chapter 6.

label.en: Why a GPU does not snoop

reason.zh: 第 10 章拿多核那篇第 3 章的窥探协议对照，说明 GPU 为什么不在各个 SM 的 L1 之间做一致性。
reason.en: Chapter 10 contrasts the multicore essay’s snooping protocols (its chapter 3) to explain why a GPU does not keep its SMs’ L1 caches coherent.

label.en: A directory has the same cost

reason.zh: 第 10 章说，CPU 靠窥探或多核那篇第 4 章的目录让副本一致；搬到一百多个 SM、几十万个线程上，这份开销大多白花。
reason.en: Chapter 10 notes that CPUs keep copies coherent by snooping or with the multicore essay’s directories (its chapter 4); across a hundred-odd SMs and hundreds of thousands of threads that cost is mostly wasted.

reason.zh: 第 10 章最外一级的显存，游戏卡用的是内存那篇（B3）第 9 章讲的 GDDR7。
reason.en: The outermost level in chapter 10, on gaming cards, is the GDDR7 that the memory-bus essay covers in its chapter 9.

reason.zh: 第 11 章的多卡系统靠片间互连那篇第 8 章的 NVLink 和 NVSwitch 连成一台机器。
reason.en: Chapter 11’s multi-GPU systems are joined into one machine by the NVLink and NVSwitch of the interconnect essay’s chapter 8.
